answer: No, an NW-POA-1 signed before February 1, 2026 is only accepted until June 30, 2026, so it won't be valid for your July 10 appointment. Your mom will need to sign the newer power of attorney form, NW-POA-2, which replaced NW-POA-1. NW-POA-2 can be signed electronically with no notary, except in Georgia, where it must still be notarized. Bring your own photo ID and the car's documents to the appointment.
